label: Tokino Sora debuts
detail: hololive begins with its first virtual talent, laying the groundwork for the agency.

label: Gen 1 & Gen 2 launch · GAMERS formed
detail: Rapid growth: Aki, Matsuri, Haato lead Gen 1; Subaru, Ayame, Shion, Choco join Gen 2; the GAMERS branch forms around Fubuki and Mio.

label: hololive Fantasy · ID branch opens
detail: Pekora, Marine, Noel and Flare arrive; Indonesia's Area 15 (Risu, Moona, Iofi) starts the international era.

label: EN Myth debuts · global explosion
detail: Calli, Kiara and Ina headline the first EN generation as hololive viewership explodes worldwide.

label: IRyS · Promise · holoX
detail: IRyS debuts solo; Council members become Promise; Japan's sixth generation holoX arrives as a secret-society unit.

label: ID holoh3ro
detail: Kaela, Kobo and Zeta complete the Indonesian third generation.

label: EN Advent · DEV_IS ReGLOSS
detail: Advent's five 'prisoners' break out in July; November introduces ReGLOSS, a music-first JP generation under the DEV_IS project.

label: EN Justice · Flow Glow announced
detail: Justice brings a British-led roster to EN; DEV_IS reveals its second generation, Flow Glow.

label: hololive OFFICIAL CARD GAME launches (JP)
detail: Start Decks and Booster Pack Vol.1 'Blooming Radiance' hit Japanese shelves.

label: English edition launches worldwide
detail: hBP01 Blooming Radiance and Start Deck releases bring the game to global players.

label: Rapid expansion
detail: Quarterly boosters (Curious Universe, Enchant Regalia, Ayakashi Vermilion) and Oshi-themed Start Decks grow the meta.
